fases.texto_objetivo: A furious screech echoes amid the dripping dark...
Beneath the glittering gold hums a tiny sweet voice...
Greed melts into a strange, hopping little jig...
One rusted key — the cave's deepest secret gasps open...

frases: THIEVES! THIEVES! Out of my hoard! This gold is MINE! Every coin, every trinket — MINE!

opciones.etiqueta: We came for the Sun Crystal.
opciones.respuesta: The SUN CRYSTAL? HAH! Not a chance! That crystal is my crown jewel — brighter than a thousand torches! You'll never touch it!
Passing THROUGH? Through MY lair? Ha! 'Passing through' means 'stealing everything' in thief language! I've heard that lie a hundred times!

frases: You tread dangerous ground, sailor! My bone throne has seen a hundred trespassers, and every single one ended up as fertilizer for the mushroom gardens!

opciones.respuesta: Quick, slow, I care not! All intruders end the same way — as compost! HA!
LIES! Everything is worth stealing! I once lost my favorite skull to a mouse! A MOUSE! I've hated mice ever since!

frases: OHHH! What a song! What a beautiful, magical song! This shell has brought more joy to my heart than all the gold in my hoard! Take anything you want — ANYTHING!

opciones.respuesta: HA! Wise choice! Here — catch! Use it on my finest coffer — the big one behind the throne. You've earned it, song-bringer!
LEAVE? Already? Ahh, well, a gift deserves a gift! Take this rusty key to my secret coffer — a proper reward for the best music I've heard in decades!

frases: I've been dancing all afternoon! This shell is my new best friend! It hums even when I put it down — such magic, such wonder!

opciones.respuesta: Happy? I'm ECSTATIC! I shall name it Flourish! My first musical treasure!

opciones.etiqueta: We'll just take our reward and go.
opciones.respuesta: Take whatever your heart desires, friend! As long as you don't take THIS shell — it's MINE now! I'll guard it with my life!

frases: A seashell for me! Let me inspect it... mmm, it hums. It glows. WITCHERY! Pure WITCHERY!

opciones.respuesta: My ear? Very well... OH! OH-HO! Singing! Whales! SECRETS OF THE DEEP! You've given me a great treasure, sailor! I accept!
Goodwill? GOODWILL! Ha! Fine — I'll take it! But if this is a trick, you'll end up as a necklace on my throne!

frases: Ah, my old rusty key! I remember giving it to you — good times! I bet it opened my coffer like a charm!

opciones.respuesta: Marvelous! I knew you were trustworthy! Enjoy whatever treasure you found — I've got plenty more!
Eh? Still haven't opened it? Well, hurry up! I want to hear about the gold inside!

acciones.descripcion: You mock his crooked crown. The Goblin King shrieks, fangs bared, and slams his fist upon the throne's armrest.
The king scoops up a fistful of coins, lets them trickle between his claws, and giggles with greedy glee.

frases: Hold your nerve, Captain. You've weathered worse storms than a noisey goblin on a throne of bones.
That crystal isn't going to save itself. Focus. Don't let his screeching get under your skin.
A pink seashell... nestled between solid gold bricks. Odd. But sometimes the strangest things are the best currency.
If this shell sings half as sweet as it looks, we might just buy our way into that coffer.
He's dancing like a drunken herring. Fine — let the little tyrant have his fun. That key is ours.
If I didn't need that key, I'd watch him trip over his own crown for hours.
There it is... the Sun Crystal. By the tides, the stories didn't do it justice. Saltmere, we're coming home.
This light... it could break the curse. I can feel it. Time to set sail and save our crew.

acciones.descripcion: Mara crouches over the coins, sifting them through her fingers, squinting at the glint of old treasure.
Mara exhales slowly, her breath clouding in the cold air as she studies the towering throne of bones.

interaccion.descripcion: A fragile shell, blushing pink, humming with a faint, impossibly sweet melody. It seems almost to sing to the cavern.

acciones.descripcion: You press the shell to your ear. A drowsy lullaby hums out, curling through the cold air like a thread of warmth.

interaccion.descripcion: A heavy iron key crusted with rust, still warm as if clutched moments ago. It smells of old gold and ancient spite.
With a groan of tortured hinges the chest yawns open, spilling a bloom of golden light across the cavern floor.

interaccion.texto_activacion: The Sun Crystal pulses, flooding the cave with a warm aurora. Treasure dims to nothing beside its quiet dawn.

acciones.descripcion: You cup your hands around the crystal. A shimmer of golden sparks spirals up through the darkness.

interaccion.texto_activacion: The torch flares to life, its flames licking the damp stone walls and casting dancing shadows.
interaccion.texto_desactivacion: You extinguish the torch, plunging the cave back into cold, oppressive darkness.

zonas_narrativas.texto: Cold drips echo from unseen heights. In the gloom, the glint of gold swallows the cave like a hungry maw.
A throne of bones rises from the deepest shadow. Upon it, two small, furious eyes fix upon you like embers.
